ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Integrative Exercise Approaches to Health - This course explore the theory and application of a variety of integrative health practices (e.g., meditation traditions, mindfulness, yoga, tai-chi, etc.). Students will learn about the epidemiology and popularity of these practices and the scientifically documented physical and psychosocial health benefits. The format for the course will be a combination of lectures, experiential activities, and student presentations.
